sources.title: Allenby Border Crossing: current notices
sources.officialityEvidence: The Israel Airports Authority's current Allenby crossing page carries a July 2026 operating-hours notice for the inbound passenger hall.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Inbound Passenger Hall ... entering Israel only.

sources.title: Allenby Border Crossing: about
sources.officialityEvidence: The authority operating the Israel-Jordan Allenby terminal describes the route's Palestinian West Bank and tourist functions, halls, and Israeli border services.
sources.supportingExcerpt: mainly for the Palestinian population and tourists with various citizenships.

sources.title: Allenby Border Crossing: contacts
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Israel Airports Authority terminal contact page identifies permit coordination, District Coordination and Liaison, and the Population and Immigration Authority entry officer.

sources.title: Population Registry
sources.publisher: Coordination of Government Activities in the Territories
sources.officialityEvidence: COGAT's current government unit page assigns handling of Palestinian Authority requests for foreign visitors' permits to the Israeli-side population registry, subject to COGAT approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Palestinian Authority requests for visitors' permits for foreigners.

sources.title: Visa practices applicable to Turkish citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs publishes its current passport-type travel and visa table on mfa.gov.tr.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For Palestine, Turkish citizens have no Palestinian visa, but need an Israeli visa, except those entering Gaza via Egypt.

sources.title: Israel entry: current country and passport data
sources.officialityEvidence: The live israel-entry.piba.gov.il API is operated by Israel's Population and Immigration Authority.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The live Turkey row marks NEED_PERMIT 1 for national and biometric national passports.
